purpose: Say that no available method can achieve a goal.
keywords: I have no contact information and no way to check.
There is no way to restore the deleted records.
At that moment, I had no means of protecting myself.
restrictions: 術 is read すべ; it concerns means or methods.
mistake: It is not the skill noun じゅつ in this expression.
